svg.title: A coordinating agent launches two workers and checks their work
svg.desc: Three agents collaborate: the coordinating agent in the main session launches an analysis agent and a figure agent. The workers develop complementary code, either in different files in one project folder or in separate Git worktrees with shared history. The coordinating agent then integrates their changes and runs an analysis-to-figure check. The repeated coordinator icon and label refer to the same main-session agent. Git logo by Jason Long, CC BY 3.0.
svg.text: Coordinating agent checks the combined workflow
Runs the analysis and figure code together
